# Step - count

`count` · category: [Aggregation](../../traversal/step_reference.md#aggregation)

Counts the traversers (bulk included); with Scope.local counts the elements of each incoming collection.

## Forms

```text
count()
count(arg1: Scope)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v().has_label("person").count().next()   // 4
```
